_comment: REPLICATE of gate_config_finals.json for v3.14 (finals_preregistration_v3_14.json): identical rules, threshold, se_ref, references and guardrails; ONLY seeds differ (1300..1302, never used before). Safety-gate SLA for twin-v2 policies (suite finals-v3). PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-30 before any v2 candidate existed (the v2.0.0 training run was in progress; no v2 checkpoint had been evaluated). The gate reads everything from here, never from CLI flags. Score per episode = 0.4*(1-min(1,fail_rate)) + 0.3*(1-min(1,pp_rate)) + 0.3*min(1, mean_SE/se_ref), rates per UE-minute; worst case = MIN over every (scenario, fading, seed). Threshold 0.63 = ~90% of the per-cell best-tuned A3's own worst case (0.705, rush_hour/rayleigh seed 1102) on this suite; calibration on baselines only (global A3 0.123, stock A3 0.414 would both FAIL this gate). Guardrails: per (scenario,fading) cell, candidate mean HO rate <= ho_rel*ref + ho_abs and mean (RLF+HOF) rate <= fail_rel*ref + fail_abs, ref = per-cell tuned A3 on the same traces.
